args.root_cause: withdraw() locked only the debited account (SELECT ... WHERE id=%s FOR UPDATE) but validated SUM(balance) over the whole household without locking the partner row. Two concurrent withdrawals on the two partner accounts of one household both read the pre-debit combined balance, both pass the combined>=amount check, then both debit, driving combined balance negative.
